title: Surreal Cosmic Eye
description: A highly detailed surreal illustration centered on a large human eye with a vibrant green iris containing a purple tunnel and tiny planets. A green skeleton emerges from a swirling red vortex below, while an astronaut stands on geometric terrain to the left, all surrounded by smiley faces, a ladybug planet, aliens, and abstract symbols.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic illustration featuring a giant detailed human eye with long lashes, the green iris containing a purple swirling vortex tunnel with a tiny sun and planets. A neon green skeleton rises from a swirling red and black vortex at the bottom right, one arm raised. To the left an astronaut with a backpack stands on geometric patterned ground. Upper left shows a red ladybug-like planet with rings, upper right has a cluster of bright yellow smiley faces with stars for eyes, scattered aliens, triangles, and abstract symbols throughout on an off-white background.
